Net Profit is the group loss for the year; the loss attributable to owners of the parent was (87,731) and to non-controlling interests (12,111). Gates tie: 138,160 less 55,163 equals 82,997 and (128,026) less (28,184) equals (99,842). | CRON 20261025_155306: period columns and blank cells synchronised between the PPR and PPR.JO keys from whichever of the two already held the verified figures (same company name and currency, no value overwritten where the two disagreed); no new figure was collected in this step. | CRON 20261124: FY2021 column filled from the FY2022 audited statements' restated 2021 column (row sources carry the detail).
